tasks.title: Develop public static office hours page
tasks.description: Implement the public web page to display the required opening hours text string without any additional features.

tasks.title: Configure hosting and domain
tasks.description: Deploy the page using the existing company hosting environment and company domain.

acceptance_criteria.given: An office visitor navigates to the public web page
acceptance_criteria.then: the text 'Monday to Friday, 09:00-17:00' is displayed on the screen

acceptance_criteria.given: A visitor is not signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the visitor navigates to the public web page
acceptance_criteria.then: the visitor can view the opening hours text without a sign-in prompt

acceptance_criteria.given: A visitor is browsing the page
acceptance_criteria.when: the visitor interacts with the page
acceptance_criteria.then: no options for editing, booking, or creating accounts are accessible or visible

acceptance_criteria.given: The application is ready for release
acceptance_criteria.then: the application is hosted on the existing company hosting environment and accessible via the existing company domain

raci.activity: Implement static page and configure infrastructure
